title: APPSim-Bench: Bridging Real-world Apps and Reproducible Evaluation for Mobile GUI Agents
abstract: arXiv:2609.07712v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Mobile GUI agents can execute tasks from natural-language instructions, but their evaluation remains difficult to make both realistic and reproducible. Existing benchmarks typically trade off these goals: simplified apps lack real-world mobile complexity, whereas live commercial apps introduce uncontrolled variation from recommendations, advertisements, accounts, and changing content. We propose AppSim-Bench, which addresses this trade-off through controllable simulated apps that preserve task-relevant interaction logic while supporting deterministic evaluation. Built through a coding-agent-assisted and human-verified workflow, it contains 557 tasks across 17 high-frequency Chinese and English apps. Its controllable backend data and outcome-based verification remove major sources of environmental stochasticity, enabling reproducible cross-model comparison. translated_title: APPSim-Bench：连接真实世界应用与可复现评估的移动GUI智能体基准
translated_abstract: 移动GUI智能体能够根据自然语言指令执行任务，但如何使其评估既真实又可复现仍然很困难。现有基准通常需要在这两个目标之间进行权衡：简化的应用缺乏真实移动环境的复杂性，而实时商业应用则会引入来自推荐、广告、账户和内容变化的不受控变数。我们提出了AppSim-Bench，通过可控的模拟应用来解决这一权衡问题，这些模拟应用保留了与任务相关的交互逻辑，同时支持确定性评估。该基准通过编码智能体辅助和人工验证的工作流程构建，包含覆盖17个高频中英文应用的557个任务。其可控的后端数据和基于结果的验证消除了环境随机性的主要来源，实现了可复现的跨模型比较。我们评估了19个GUI智能体，涵盖通用系统和GUI专用系统……
tldr: 提出AppSim-Bench基准，通过保留任务相关交互逻辑的可控模拟应用，包含17个高频中英文应用中的557个任务，解决了移动GUI智能体评估中真实性与可复现性难以兼得的问题。
en_tdlr: Proposes AppSim-Bench, a benchmark with controllable simulated apps that preserve real-world interaction logic, comprising 557 tasks across 17 high-frequency Chinese and English apps, enabling both realistic and reproducible evaluation of mobile GUI agents.
